scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind analyse charts and tables.
Count: tells how many items are present. Sum: adds numbers together.
Average: shares a total evenly across the number of values. Maximum: is the largest value. Minimum: is the smallest value.
Collect a few harmless facts about classroom materials, NOT personal details. Make a paper chart with the terms Count, Sum and Average; explain what each means.
